                }).join('');

                const values = [r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], coresText, clockCacheText, tdpGpuText, reviewText];
                const tds = values.map((val, cIdx) => {
                    if (cIdx === 0) {
                        const star = isHighlight ? '<span style="color:#16a34a; margin-right:3px;">★</span>' : '';
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 9px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; color:${customFontColor}; font-weight:${fontWeight};"><div style="font-size:11.5px;">${star}<b>${val || '-'}</b></div><div style="margin-top:2px;">${badgesHTML}</div></td>`;
                    } else if (cIdx === 4) {
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 8px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; font-weight:700; color:#4f46e5; white-space:nowrap; font-size:10.5px;">${val || '-'}</td>`;
                    } else if (cIdx === 5 || cIdx === 6 || cIdx === 7) {
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 8px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; color:#0f172a; font-weight:600; font-size:10.5px; white-space:nowrap;">${val || '-'}</td>`;
                    } else {
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 8px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; color:#334155; font-size:10.5px; line-height:1.3;">${val || '-'}</td>`;
                    }
                }).join('');

                return `<tr class="matrix-data-row" style="border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; ${rowBg}">${tds}</tr>`;
            }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#94a3b8;">${L.noMatch}</td></tr>`;

            if (pageInfo) pageInfo.innerHTML = `${L.pageInfo} <b>${totalCount === 0 ? 0 : startIdx + 1} - ${Math.min(startIdx + PAGE_SIZE, totalCount)}</b> ${L.ofTotal} <b>${totalCount}</b> ${L.modelsText} (${L.activeFilterText} ${selectedTags.size} ${L.filtersText})`;
            if (pageNum) pageNum.innerHTML = `${L.pageText} <b>${currentPage}</b> / ${totalPages} ${L.pagesUnit}`;
            if (prevBtn) {
                prevBtn.disabled = (currentPage <= 1);
                prevBtn.style.opacity = currentPage <= 1 ? "0.4" : "1";
                prevBtn.textContent = L.prevPage;
            }
            if (nextBtn) {
                nextBtn.disabled = (currentPage >= totalPages);
                nextBtn.style.opacity = currentPage >= totalPages ? "0.4" : "1";
                nextBtn.textContent = L.nextPage;
            }
        }

        function render() {
            const L = I18N_CPU_TRUE_100[componentLang];

            const vendorTags = ["Intel", "AMD"];
            const socketTags = ["LGA1700", "LGA1851", "AM4", "AM5"];
            const tierTags = ["i9 旗舰", "R9 旗舰", "Ultra 9 旗舰", "i7 高端", "R7 高端", "Ultra 7 高端", "i5 主流", "R5 主流", "Ultra 5 主流", "i3 入门", "R3 入门"];
            const featureTags = ["3D缓存", "可超频", "无核显", "APU强核显"];
            const intelGenTags = ["酷睿 12 代", "酷睿 13 代", "酷睿 14 代", "酷睿 Ultra 200S"];
            const amdGenTags = ["锐龙 3000", "锐龙 4000/G", "锐龙 5000", "锐龙 7000", "锐龙 8000G", "锐龙 9000"];

            function buildBtn(tag, label, customBg) {
                const isActive = selectedTags.has(tag);
                const bg = isActive ? "#0f172a" : (customBg || "#f1f5f9");
                const clr = isActive ? "#ffffff" : "#334155";
                const bdr = isActive ? "#0f172a" : "#e2e8f0";
                const checkIcon = isActive ? "✓ " : "";
                return `<button type="button" class="tag-filter-btn" data-tag="${tag}" style="padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid ${bdr}; background:${bg}; color:${clr}; font-size:10px; font-weight:${isActive ? '700' : '600'}; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap;">${checkIcon}${label || tag}</button>`;
            }

            const activeTagsCount = selectedTags.size;
            const resetBtnHTML = activeTagsCount > 0 
                ? `<button type="button" class="btn-clear-tags" style="padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px dashed #10b981; background:#ecfdf5; color:#059669; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;">${L.resetBtn} (${activeTagsCount})</button>`
                : '';

            const filterBarHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; font-size:10.5px;">
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#475569; min-width:65px;">${L.vendorLabel}</span>
                        ${vendorTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, t === 'Intel' ? '#e0f2fe' : '#ffedd5')).join('')}
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#475569; margin-left:8px; min-width:55px;">${L.socketLabel}</span>
                        ${socketTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#f3f4f6")).join('')}
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#475569; margin-left:8px; min-width:55px;">${L.featureLabel}</span>
                        ${featureTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#fef3c7")).join('')}
                        ${resetBtnHTML}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#0284c7; min-width:65px;">${L.intelLabel}</span>
                        ${intelGenTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#f0f9ff")).join('')}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#ea580c; min-width:65px;">${L.amdLabel}</span>
                        ${amdGenTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#fff7ed")).join('')}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#4f46e5; min-width:65px;">${L.tierLabel}</span>
                        ${tierTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#eef2ff")).join('')}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            const ths = L.headers.map(h => `<th style="padding:8px 9px; font-weight:700; color:#334155; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; white-space:nowrap; background:#f1f5f9; font-size:11px;">${h}</th>`).join('');
            const oldSearchVal = container.querySelector('.matrix-search-box') ? container.querySelector('.matrix-search-box').value : '';

            const langSelectorHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-size:11px; background:#e2e8f0; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px;">
                    <span>${L.langLabel}</span>
                    <select class="matrix-lang-switcher" style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:3px; padding:2px 4px; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer; outline:none;">
                        <option value="zh-CN" ${componentLang === 'zh-CN' ? 'selected' : ''}>简体中文</option>
                        <option value="zh-TW" ${componentLang === 'zh-TW' ? 'selected' : ''}>繁體中文</option>
                        <option value="en" ${componentLang === 'en' ? 'selected' : ''}>English</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
            `;

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="padding:10px 14px; background:#f8fafc; border-bottom:2px solid #10b981; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px;">
                    <div>
                        <h2 style="margin:0; font-size:15px; font-weight:800; color:#059669;">${L.title}</h2>
                        <span class="matrix-editor-only" style="font-size:10.5px; color:#64748b; display:inline-block;">${L.subTitle}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        ${langSelectorHTML}
                        <input type="text" class="matrix-search-box" value="${oldSearchVal}" placeholder="${L.searchPlaceholder}" style="padding:5px 9px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; outline:none; width:250px;">
                        <div style="background:#10b981; color:#ffffff; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700;">${L.badgeText}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:8px 14px; background:#ffffff; border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; max-height:160px; overflow-y:auto;">
                    ${filterBarHTML}
                </div>
                <div style="flex:1; min-height:550px; overflow:auto; padding:10px;">
                    <div style="border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:5px; overflow:hidden;">
                        <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; text-align:left; font-size:11px;">
                            <thead><tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #cbd5e1;">${ths}</tr></thead>
                            <tbody class="matrix-table-tbody"></tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:8px 14px; background:#f8fafc; border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:11px; color:#64748b;">
                    <div class="matrix-page-info"></div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        <button type="button" class="btn-prev-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.prevPage}</button>
                        <span class="matrix-current-page-num"></span>
                        <button type="button" class="btn-next-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.nextPage}</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            updateTableOnly();
        }

        container.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-lang-switcher')) {
                componentLang = e.target.value;
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('cpu_matrix_lang', componentLang);
                } catch(err) {}
                render();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-search-box')) {
                currentPage = 1;
                updateTableOnly();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            const tagBtn = e.target.closest('.tag-filter-btn') || e.target.closest('.row-tag-badge');
            if (tagBtn && tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag')) {
                const tag = tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag');
                if (selectedTags.has(tag)) {
                    selectedTags.delete(tag);
                } else {
                    selectedTags.add(tag);
                }
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-clear-tags')) {
                selectedTags.clear();
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-prev-page')) {
                if (currentPage > 1) {
                    currentPage--;
                    updateTableOnly();
                }
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-next-page')) {
                currentPage++;
                updateTableOnly();
                return;
            }
        });

        render();

    } catch (err) {
        console.error("Desktop CPU Matrix Render Error:", err);
    }
})();

                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#475569; min-width:65px;">${L.platformLabel}</span>
                        ${platformTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, t==='Intel'?'#e0f2fe':'#fee2e2')).join('')}
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#475569; margin-left:8px; min-width:45px;">${L.formLabel}</span>
                        ${formTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#ecfdf5")).join('')}
                        ${resetBtnHTML}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#4338ca; min-width:65px;">${L.seriesLabel}</span>
                        ${seriesTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#eef2ff")).join('')}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#0284c7; min-width:65px;">${L.intelLabel}</span>
                        ${intelChipsets.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#f0f9ff")).join('')}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#dc2626; min-width:65px;">${L.amdLabel}</span>
                        ${amdChipsets.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#fff1f2")).join('')}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            const ths = L.headers.map(h => `<th style="padding:8px 9px; font-weight:700; color:#334155; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; white-space:nowrap; background:#f1f5f9; font-size:11px;">${h}</th>`).join('');
            const oldSearchVal = container.querySelector('.matrix-search-box') ? container.querySelector('.matrix-search-box').value : '';

            const langSelectorHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-size:11px; background:#e2e8f0; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px;">
                    <span>${L.langLabel}</span>
                    <select class="matrix-lang-switcher" style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:3px; padding:2px 4px; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer; outline:none;">
                        <option value="zh-CN" ${componentLang === 'zh-CN' ? 'selected' : ''}>简体中文</option>
                        <option value="zh-TW" ${componentLang === 'zh-TW' ? 'selected' : ''}>繁體中文</option>
                        <option value="en" ${componentLang === 'en' ? 'selected' : ''}>English</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
            `;

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="padding:10px 14px; background:#f8fafc; border-bottom:2px solid #ef4444; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px;">
                    <div>
                        <h2 style="margin:0; font-size:15px; font-weight:800; color:#dc2626;">${L.title}</h2>
                        <span class="matrix-editor-only" style="font-size:10.5px; color:#64748b; display:inline-block;">${L.subTitle}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        ${langSelectorHTML}
                        <input type="text" class="matrix-search-box" value="${oldSearchVal}" placeholder="${L.searchPlaceholder}" style="padding:5px 9px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; outline:none; width:220px;">
                        <div style="background:#dc2626; color:#ffffff; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700;">${L.badgeText}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:8px 14px; background:#ffffff; border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; max-height:140px; overflow-y:auto;">
                    ${filterBarHTML}
                </div>
                <div style="flex:1; min-height:550px; overflow:auto; padding:10px;">
                    <div style="border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:5px; overflow:hidden;">
                        <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; text-align:left; font-size:11px;">
                            <thead><tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #cbd5e1;">${ths}</tr></thead>
                            <tbody class="matrix-table-tbody"></tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:8px 14px; background:#f8fafc; border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:11px; color:#64748b;">
                    <div class="matrix-page-info"></div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        <button type="button" class="btn-prev-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.prevPage}</button>
                        <span class="matrix-current-page-num"></span>
                        <button type="button" class="btn-next-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.nextPage}</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            updateTableOnly();
        }

        container.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-lang-switcher')) {
                componentLang = e.target.value;
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('asus_matrix_lang', componentLang);
                } catch(err) {}
                render();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-search-box')) {
                currentPage = 1;
                updateTableOnly();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            const tagBtn = e.target.closest('.tag-filter-btn') || e.target.closest('.row-tag-badge');
            if (tagBtn && tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag')) {
                const tag = tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag');
                if (selectedTags.has(tag)) {
                    selectedTags.delete(tag);
                } else {
                    selectedTags.add(tag);
                }
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-clear-tags')) {
                selectedTags.clear();
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-prev-page')) {
                if (currentPage > 1) {
                    currentPage--;
                    updateTableOnly();
                }
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-next-page')) {
                currentPage++;
                updateTableOnly();
                return;
            }
        });

        render();

    } catch (err) {
        console.error("ASUS Motherboard Matrix Render Error:", err);
    }
})();

                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        <button type="button" class="btn-prev-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.prevPage}</button>
                        <span class="matrix-current-page-num"></span>
                        <button type="button" class="btn-next-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.nextPage}</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            updateTableOnly();
        }

        container.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-lang-switcher')) {
                componentLang = e.target.value;
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('gigabyte_matrix_lang', componentLang);
                } catch(err) {}
                render();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-search-box')) {
                currentPage = 1;
                updateTableOnly();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            const tagBtn = e.target.closest('.tag-filter-btn') || e.target.closest('.row-tag-badge');
            if (tagBtn && tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag')) {
                const tag = tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag');
                if (selectedTags.has(tag)) {
                    selectedTags.delete(tag);
                } else {
                    selectedTags.add(tag);
                }
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-clear-tags')) {
                selectedTags.clear();
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-prev-page')) {
                if (currentPage > 1) {
                    currentPage--;
                    updateTableOnly();
                }
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-next-page')) {
                currentPage++;
                updateTableOnly();
                return;
            }
        });

        render();

    } catch (err) {
        console.error("GIGABYTE Motherboard Matrix Render Error:", err);
    }
})();

                        <option value="en" ${componentLang === 'en' ? 'selected' : ''}>English</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
            `;

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="padding:10px 14px; background:#f8fafc; border-bottom:2px solid #ef4444; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px;">
                    <div>
                        <h2 style="margin:0; font-size:15px; font-weight:800; color:#dc2626;">${L.title}</h2>
                        <span class="matrix-editor-only" style="font-size:10.5px; color:#64748b; display:inline-block;">${L.subTitle}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        ${langSelectorHTML}
                        <input type="text" class="matrix-search-box" value="${oldSearchVal}" placeholder="${L.searchPlaceholder}" style="padding:5px 9px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; outline:none; width:220px;">
                        <div style="background:#dc2626; color:#ffffff; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700;">${L.badgeText}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:8px 14px; background:#ffffff; border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; max-height:140px; overflow-y:auto;">
                    ${filterBarHTML}
                </div>
                <div style="flex:1; min-height:550px; overflow:auto; padding:10px;">
                    <div style="border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:5px; overflow:hidden;">
                        <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; text-align:left; font-size:11px;">
                            <thead><tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #cbd5e1;">${ths}</tr></thead>
                            <tbody class="matrix-table-tbody"></tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:8px 14px; background:#f8fafc; border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:11px; color:#64748b;">
                    <div class="matrix-page-info"></div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        <button type="button" class="btn-prev-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.prevPage}</button>
                        <span class="matrix-current-page-num"></span>
                        <button type="button" class="btn-next-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.nextPage}</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            updateTableOnly();
        }

        container.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-lang-switcher')) {
                componentLang = e.target.value;
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('msi_matrix_lang', componentLang);
                } catch(err) {}
                render();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-search-box')) {
                currentPage = 1;
                updateTableOnly();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            const tagBtn = e.target.closest('.tag-filter-btn') || e.target.closest('.row-tag-badge');
            if (tagBtn && tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag')) {
                const tag = tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag');
                if (selectedTags.has(tag)) {
                    selectedTags.delete(tag);
                } else {
                    selectedTags.add(tag);
                }
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-clear-tags')) {
                selectedTags.clear();
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-prev-page')) {
                if (currentPage > 1) {
                    currentPage--;
                    updateTableOnly();
                }
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-next-page')) {
                currentPage++;
                updateTableOnly();
                return;
            }
        });

        render();

    } catch (err) {
        console.error("MSI Motherboard Matrix Render Error:", err);
    }
})();

        ];

        let selectedTags = new Set();
        let currentPage = 1;
        const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

        const container = document.createElement('div');
        container.className = 'inline-tag-matrix';
        // 华擎主色调科技蓝 (0ea5e9) 风格
        container.style.cssText = 'width:100%; height:100%; min-height:850px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#ffffff; margin:0; padding:0; overflow:hidden; font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; box-sizing:border-box; border:none;';
        element.appendChild(container);

        function getFilteredRows() {
            const sInp = container.querySelector('.matrix-search-box');
            const query = sInp ? sInp.value.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
            const activeTagsArr = Array.from(selectedTags).map(t => t.toLowerCase());

            return ASROCK_TRUE_100_DATA.filter(r => {
                const rowTags = [r[1].toLowerCase(), r[2].toLowerCase(), r[3].toLowerCase(), r[4].toLowerCase(), ...(r[14] || []).map(t => t.toLowerCase())];
                const text = (r.join(' ') + ' ' + rowTags.join(' ')).toLowerCase();
                const matchAllTags = activeTagsArr.every(selected => rowTags.includes(selected));
                const matchQuery = !query || (text.indexOf(query) !== -1);
                return matchAllTags && matchQuery;
            });
        }

        function updateTableOnly() {
            const L = I18N_ASROCK_TRUE_100[componentLang];

            const tbody = container.querySelector('.matrix-table-tbody');
            const pageInfo = container.querySelector('.matrix-page-info');
            const prevBtn = container.querySelector('.btn-prev-page');
            const nextBtn = container.querySelector('.btn-next-page');
            const pageNum = container.querySelector('.matrix-current-page-num');
            if (!tbody) return;

            const filteredRows = getFilteredRows();
            const totalCount = filteredRows.length;
            const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalCount / PAGE_SIZE) || 1;
            if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = 1;

            const startIdx = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
            const currentRows = filteredRows.slice(startIdx, startIdx + PAGE_SIZE);

            tbody.innerHTML = currentRows.map((r, idx) => {
                const isHighlight = r[15] === 1;
                const rowBg = isHighlight ? 'background-color:#f0f9ff;' : (idx % 2 === 0 ? 'background-color:#ffffff;' : 'background-color:#fafaf9;');
                const customFontColor = r[1] === "Intel" ? "#0284c7" : "#ea580c"; // 华擎Intel偏蓝，AMD偏橙/红
                const fontWeight = isHighlight ? '700' : '500';

                let powerText = r[5];
                let specsText = r[8];
                let reviewText = r[11];
                if (componentLang === 'zh-TW') {
                    powerText = r[6];
                    specsText = r[9];
                    reviewText = r[12];
                } else if (componentLang === 'en') {
                    powerText = r[7];
                    specsText = r[10];
                    reviewText = r[13];
                }

                const badges = [r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], ...(r[14] || [])];
                const badgesHTML = badges.slice(0, 5).map(t => {
                    const isSelected = selectedTags.has(t);
                    const badgeBg = isSelected ? '#0ea5e9' : 'rgba(14,165,233,0.08)'; 
                    const badgeColor = isSelected ? '#ffffff' : '#0ea5e9';
                    return `<span class="row-tag-badge" data-tag="${t}" style="display:inline-block; font-size:9px; padding:1px 4px; border-radius:3px; background:${badgeBg}; color:${badgeColor}; margin-right:2px; margin-top:2px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;">#${t}</span>`;
                }).join('');

                const values = [r[0], L.vendorName, r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], powerText, specsText, reviewText];
                const tds = values.map((val, cIdx) => {
                    if (cIdx === 0) {
                        const star = isHighlight ? '<span style="color:#0ea5e9; margin-right:3px;">★</span>' : '';
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 9px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; color:${customFontColor}; font-weight:${fontWeight};"><div style="font-size:11.5px;">${star}<b>${val || '-'}</b></div><div style="margin-top:2px;">${badgesHTML}</div></td>`;
                    } else if (cIdx === 5) {
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 8px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; font-weight:700; color:#4338ca; white-space:nowrap; font-size:10.5px;">${val || '-'}</td>`;
                    } else if (cIdx === 6) {
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 8px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; color:#0f172a; font-weight:600; font-size:10.5px; white-space:nowrap;">${val || '-'}</td>`;
                    } else {
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 8px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; color:#334155; font-size:10.5px; line-height:1.3;">${val || '-'}</td>`;
                    }
                }).join('');

                return `<tr class="matrix-data-row" style="border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; ${rowBg}">${tds}</tr>`;
            }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#94a3b8;">${L.noMatch}</td></tr>`;

            if (pageInfo) pageInfo.innerHTML = `${L.pageInfo} <b>${totalCount === 0 ? 0 : startIdx + 1} - ${Math.min(startIdx + PAGE_SIZE, totalCount)}</b> ${L.ofTotal} <b>${totalCount}</b> ${L.modelsText} (${L.activeFilterText} ${selectedTags.size} ${L.filtersText})`;
            if (pageNum) pageNum.innerHTML = `${L.pageText} <b>${currentPage}</b> / ${totalPages} ${L.pagesUnit}`;
            if (prevBtn) {
                prevBtn.disabled = (currentPage <= 1);
                prevBtn.style.opacity = currentPage <= 1 ? "0.4" : "1";
                prevBtn.textContent = L.prevPage;
            }
            if (nextBtn) {
                nextBtn.disabled = (currentPage >= totalPages);
                nextBtn.style.opacity = currentPage >= totalPages ? "0.4" : "1";
                nextBtn.textContent = L.nextPage;
            }
        }

        function render() {
            const L = I18N_ASROCK_TRUE_100[componentLang];

            const platformTags = ["Intel", "AMD"];
            const seriesTags = ["Taichi", "Steel Legend", "Phantom Gaming", "PRO", "AQUA", "LiveMixer", "PROJECT ZERO", "HDV/HVS (入门)"];
            const formTags = ["ITX", "M-ATX", "ATX", "E-ATX"];
            const intelChipsets = ["H610", "B660", "H670", "Z690", "B760", "H770", "Z790", "H810", "B860", "Z890"];
            const amdChipsets = ["A320", "A520", "B450", "X470", "B550", "X570", "A620", "B650", "B650E", "X670", "X670E", "B850", "X870", "X870E"];

            function buildBtn(tag, label, customBg) {
                const isActive = selectedTags.has(tag);
                const bg = isActive ? "#0f172a" : (customBg || "#f1f5f9");
                const clr = isActive ? "#ffffff" : "#334155";
                const bdr = isActive ? "#0f172a" : "#e2e8f0";
                const checkIcon = isActive ? "✓ " : "";
                return `<button type="button" class="tag-filter-btn" data-tag="${tag}" style="padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid ${bdr}; background:${bg}; color:${clr}; font-size:10px; font-weight:${isActive ? '700' : '600'}; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap;">${checkIcon}${label || tag}</button>`;
            }

            const activeTagsCount = selectedTags.size;
            const resetBtnHTML = activeTagsCount > 0 
                ? `<button type="button" class="btn-clear-tags" style="padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px dashed #0ea5e9; background:#e0f2fe; color:#0369a1; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;">${L.resetBtn} (${activeTagsCount})</button>`
                : '';

            const filterBarHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; font-size:10.5px;">
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#475569; min-width:65px;">${L.platformLabel}</span>
                        ${platformTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, t==='Intel'?'#e0f2fe':'#ffedd5')).join('')}
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#475569; margin-left:8px; min-width:45px;">${L.formLabel}</span>
                        ${formTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#ecfdf5")).join('')}
                        ${resetBtnHTML}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#4338ca; min-width:65px;">${L.seriesLabel}</span>
                        ${seriesTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#eef2ff")).join('')}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#0284c7; min-width:65px;">${L.intelLabel}</span>
                        ${intelChipsets.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#f0f9ff")).join('')}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#ea580c; min-width:65px;">${L.amdLabel}</span>
                        ${amdChipsets.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#fff7ed")).join('')}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            const ths = L.headers.map(h => `<th style="padding:8px 9px; font-weight:700; color:#334155; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; white-space:nowrap; background:#f1f5f9; font-size:11px;">${h}</th>`).join('');
            const oldSearchVal = container.querySelector('.matrix-search-box') ? container.querySelector('.matrix-search-box').value : '';

            const langSelectorHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-size:11px; background:#e2e8f0; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px;">
                    <span>${L.langLabel}</span>
                    <select class="matrix-lang-switcher" style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:3px; padding:2px 4px; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer; outline:none;">
                        <option value="zh-CN" ${componentLang === 'zh-CN' ? 'selected' : ''}>简体中文</option>
                        <option value="zh-TW" ${componentLang === 'zh-TW' ? 'selected' : ''}>繁體中文</option>
                        <option value="en" ${componentLang === 'en' ? 'selected' : ''}>English</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
            `;

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="padding:10px 14px; background:#f8fafc; border-bottom:2px solid #0ea5e9; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px;">
                    <div>
                        <h2 style="margin:0; font-size:15px; font-weight:800; color:#0369a1;">${L.title}</h2>
                        <span class="matrix-editor-only" style="font-size:10.5px; color:#64748b; display:inline-block;">${L.subTitle}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        ${langSelectorHTML}
                        <input type="text" class="matrix-search-box" value="${oldSearchVal}" placeholder="${L.searchPlaceholder}" style="padding:5px 9px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; outline:none; width:220px;">
                        <div style="background:#0ea5e9; color:#ffffff; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700;">${L.badgeText}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:8px 14px; background:#ffffff; border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; max-height:140px; overflow-y:auto;">
                    ${filterBarHTML}
                </div>
                <div style="flex:1; min-height:550px; overflow:auto; padding:10px;">
                    <div style="border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:5px; overflow:hidden;">
                        <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; text-align:left; font-size:11px;">
                            <thead><tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #cbd5e1;">${ths}</tr></thead>
                            <tbody class="matrix-table-tbody"></tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:8px 14px; background:#f8fafc; border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:11px; color:#64748b;">
                    <div class="matrix-page-info"></div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        <button type="button" class="btn-prev-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.prevPage}</button>
                        <span class="matrix-current-page-num"></span>
                        <button type="button" class="btn-next-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.nextPage}</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            updateTableOnly();
        }

        container.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-lang-switcher')) {
                componentLang = e.target.value;
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('asrock_matrix_lang', componentLang);
                } catch(err) {}
                render();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-search-box')) {
                currentPage = 1;
                updateTableOnly();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            const tagBtn = e.target.closest('.tag-filter-btn') || e.target.closest('.row-tag-badge');
            if (tagBtn && tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag')) {
                const tag = tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag');
                if (selectedTags.has(tag)) {
                    selectedTags.delete(tag);
                } else {
                    selectedTags.add(tag);
                }
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-clear-tags')) {
                selectedTags.clear();
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-prev-page')) {
                if (currentPage > 1) {
                    currentPage--;
                    updateTableOnly();
                }
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-next-page')) {
                currentPage++;
                updateTableOnly();
                return;
            }
        });

        render();

    } catch (err) {
        console.error("ASRock Motherboard Matrix Render Error:", err);
    }
})();

            ["X870E VALKYRIE", "映泰", "AMD", "X870E", "ATX", "VALKYRIE (旗舰)", "22 相 (110A SPS)", "22 相 (110A SPS)", "22 Phase (110A SPS)", "4xDDR5, 4xM.2(1x5.0), 双USB4, 2.5G+WiFi 7", "4xDDR5, 4xM.2(1x5.0), 雙USB4, 2.5G+WiFi 7", "4xDDR5, 4xM.2(1x5.0), Dual USB4, 2.5G+Wi-Fi 7", "Zen 5 女武神新王，110A恐怖供电", "Zen 5 女武神新王，110A恐怖供電", "Zen 5 Valkyrie king, 110A insane VRM", ["旗舰极客", "X870E"], 1]
        ];

        let selectedTags = new Set();
        let currentPage = 1;
        const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

        const container = document.createElement('div');
        container.className = 'inline-tag-matrix';
        // 采用紫/靛蓝色系 (Indigo/Purple) 代表三大品牌联合的主题
        container.style.cssText = 'width:100%; height:100%; min-height:850px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#ffffff; margin:0; padding:0; overflow:hidden; font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; box-sizing:border-box; border:none;';
        element.appendChild(container);

        function getFilteredRows() {
            const sInp = container.querySelector('.matrix-search-box');
            const query = sInp ? sInp.value.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
            const activeTagsArr = Array.from(selectedTags).map(t => t.toLowerCase());

            return ALLIANCE_TRUE_100_DATA.filter(r => {
                const rowTags = [r[1].toLowerCase(), r[2].toLowerCase(), r[3].toLowerCase(), r[4].toLowerCase(), r[5].toLowerCase(), ...(r[15] || []).map(t => t.toLowerCase())];
                const text = (r.join(' ') + ' ' + rowTags.join(' ')).toLowerCase();
                const matchAllTags = activeTagsArr.every(selected => rowTags.includes(selected));
                const matchQuery = !query || (text.indexOf(query) !== -1);
                return matchAllTags && matchQuery;
            });
        }

        function updateTableOnly() {
            const L = I18N_ALLIANCE_TRUE_100[componentLang];

            const tbody = container.querySelector('.matrix-table-tbody');
            const pageInfo = container.querySelector('.matrix-page-info');
            const prevBtn = container.querySelector('.btn-prev-page');
            const nextBtn = container.querySelector('.btn-next-page');
            const pageNum = container.querySelector('.matrix-current-page-num');
            if (!tbody) return;

            const filteredRows = getFilteredRows();
            const totalCount = filteredRows.length;
            const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalCount / PAGE_SIZE) || 1;
            if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = 1;

            const startIdx = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
            const currentRows = filteredRows.slice(startIdx, startIdx + PAGE_SIZE);

            tbody.innerHTML = currentRows.map((r, idx) => {
                const isHighlight = r[16] === 1;
                const rowBg = isHighlight ? 'background-color:#f5f3ff;' : (idx % 2 === 0 ? 'background-color:#ffffff;' : 'background-color:#fafaf9;');
                
                // 联合品牌配色逻辑
                let customFontColor = "#334155";
                if (r[1] === "七彩虹") customFontColor = "#dc2626"; // 红色
                else if (r[1] === "铭瑄") customFontColor = "#16a34a"; // 绿色
                else if (r[1] === "映泰") customFontColor = "#d97706"; // 橙黄色

                const fontWeight = isHighlight ? '700' : '500';

                let powerText = r[6];
                let specsText = r[9];
                let reviewText = r[12];
                if (componentLang === 'zh-TW') {
                    powerText = r[7];
                    specsText = r[10];
                    reviewText = r[13];
                } else if (componentLang === 'en') {
                    powerText = r[8];
                    specsText = r[11];
                    reviewText = r[14];
                }

                // 获取翻译后的厂商名
                const vendorStr = VENDOR_MAP[r[1]] ? VENDOR_MAP[r[1]][componentLang] : r[1];

                const badges = [r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], ...(r[15] || [])];
                const badgesHTML = badges.slice(0, 5).map(t => {
                    const isSelected = selectedTags.has(t);
                    const badgeBg = isSelected ? '#6366f1' : 'rgba(99,102,241,0.08)'; 
                    const badgeColor = isSelected ? '#ffffff' : '#6366f1';
                    return `<span class="row-tag-badge" data-tag="${t}" style="display:inline-block; font-size:9px; padding:1px 4px; border-radius:3px; background:${badgeBg}; color:${badgeColor}; margin-right:2px; margin-top:2px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;">#${t}</span>`;
                }).join('');

                const values = [r[0], vendorStr, r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5], powerText, specsText, reviewText];
                const tds = values.map((val, cIdx) => {
                    if (cIdx === 0) {
                        const star = isHighlight ? '<span style="color:#6366f1; margin-right:3px;">★</span>' : '';
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 9px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; color:${customFontColor}; font-weight:${fontWeight};"><div style="font-size:11.5px;">${star}<b>${val || '-'}</b></div><div style="margin-top:2px;">${badgesHTML}</div></td>`;
                    } else if (cIdx === 5) {
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 8px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; font-weight:700; color:#4f46e5; white-space:nowrap; font-size:10.5px;">${val || '-'}</td>`;
                    } else if (cIdx === 6) {
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 8px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; color:#0f172a; font-weight:600; font-size:10.5px; white-space:nowrap;">${val || '-'}</td>`;
                    } else {
                        return `<td style="padding:6px 8px; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; color:#334155; font-size:10.5px; line-height:1.3;">${val || '-'}</td>`;
                    }
                }).join('');

                return `<tr class="matrix-data-row" style="border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; ${rowBg}">${tds}</tr>`;
            }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:#94a3b8;">${L.noMatch}</td></tr>`;

            if (pageInfo) pageInfo.innerHTML = `${L.pageInfo} <b>${totalCount === 0 ? 0 : startIdx + 1} - ${Math.min(startIdx + PAGE_SIZE, totalCount)}</b> ${L.ofTotal} <b>${totalCount}</b> ${L.modelsText} (${L.activeFilterText} ${selectedTags.size} ${L.filtersText})`;
            if (pageNum) pageNum.innerHTML = `${L.pageText} <b>${currentPage}</b> / ${totalPages} ${L.pagesUnit}`;
            if (prevBtn) {
                prevBtn.disabled = (currentPage <= 1);
                prevBtn.style.opacity = currentPage <= 1 ? "0.4" : "1";
                prevBtn.textContent = L.prevPage;
            }
            if (nextBtn) {
                nextBtn.disabled = (currentPage >= totalPages);
                nextBtn.style.opacity = currentPage >= totalPages ? "0.4" : "1";
                nextBtn.textContent = L.nextPage;
            }
        }

        function render() {
            const L = I18N_ALLIANCE_TRUE_100[componentLang];

            const vendorTags = ["七彩虹", "铭瑄", "映泰"];
            const platformTags = ["Intel", "AMD"];
            const seriesTags = ["旗舰极客", "中端主流", "入门性价比", "主题/背插/异形"];
            const formTags = ["ITX", "M-ATX", "ATX", "E-ATX"];
            const intelChipsets = ["H610", "B660", "H670", "Z690", "B760", "Z790", "H810", "B860", "Z890"];
            const amdChipsets = ["A320", "B450", "A520", "B550", "X570", "A620", "B650", "B650E", "X670E", "X870", "X870E"];

            function buildBtn(tag, label, customBg) {
                const isActive = selectedTags.has(tag);
                const bg = isActive ? "#0f172a" : (customBg || "#f1f5f9");
                const clr = isActive ? "#ffffff" : "#334155";
                const bdr = isActive ? "#0f172a" : "#e2e8f0";
                const checkIcon = isActive ? "✓ " : "";
                return `<button type="button" class="tag-filter-btn" data-tag="${tag}" style="padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid ${bdr}; background:${bg}; color:${clr}; font-size:10px; font-weight:${isActive ? '700' : '600'}; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap;">${checkIcon}${label || tag}</button>`;
            }

            const activeTagsCount = selectedTags.size;
            const resetBtnHTML = activeTagsCount > 0 
                ? `<button type="button" class="btn-clear-tags" style="padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px dashed #6366f1; background:#e0e7ff; color:#4338ca; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;">${L.resetBtn} (${activeTagsCount})</button>`
                : '';

            const filterBarHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; font-size:10.5px;">
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#475569; min-width:65px;">${L.vendorLabel}</span>
                        ${vendorTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#f3e8ff")).join('')}
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#475569; margin-left:8px; min-width:45px;">${L.formLabel}</span>
                        ${formTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#ecfdf5")).join('')}
                        ${resetBtnHTML}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#475569; min-width:65px;">${L.platformLabel}</span>
                        ${platformTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, t==='Intel'?'#e0f2fe':'#ffedd5')).join('')}
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#4338ca; margin-left:8px; min-width:65px;">${L.seriesLabel}</span>
                        ${seriesTags.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#eef2ff")).join('')}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#0284c7; min-width:65px;">${L.intelLabel}</span>
                        ${intelChipsets.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#f0f9ff")).join('')}
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span style="font-weight:800; color:#ea580c; min-width:65px;">${L.amdLabel}</span>
                        ${amdChipsets.map(t => buildBtn(t, "#" + t, "#fff7ed")).join('')}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            const ths = L.headers.map(h => `<th style="padding:8px 9px; font-weight:700; color:#334155; border-right:1px solid #e2e8f0; white-space:nowrap; background:#f1f5f9; font-size:11px;">${h}</th>`).join('');
            const oldSearchVal = container.querySelector('.matrix-search-box') ? container.querySelector('.matrix-search-box').value : '';

            const langSelectorHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-size:11px; background:#e2e8f0; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px;">
                    <span>${L.langLabel}</span>
                    <select class="matrix-lang-switcher" style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:3px; padding:2px 4px; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer; outline:none;">
                        <option value="zh-CN" ${componentLang === 'zh-CN' ? 'selected' : ''}>简体中文</option>
                        <option value="zh-TW" ${componentLang === 'zh-TW' ? 'selected' : ''}>繁體中文</option>
                        <option value="en" ${componentLang === 'en' ? 'selected' : ''}>English</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
            `;

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="padding:10px 14px; background:#f8fafc; border-bottom:2px solid #6366f1; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px;">
                    <div>
                        <h2 style="margin:0; font-size:15px; font-weight:800; color:#4f46e5;">${L.title}</h2>
                        <span class="matrix-editor-only" style="font-size:10.5px; color:#64748b; display:inline-block;">${L.subTitle}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        ${langSelectorHTML}
                        <input type="text" class="matrix-search-box" value="${oldSearchVal}" placeholder="${L.searchPlaceholder}" style="padding:5px 9px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; outline:none; width:220px;">
                        <div style="background:#6366f1; color:#ffffff; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700;">${L.badgeText}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:8px 14px; background:#ffffff; border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; max-height:160px; overflow-y:auto;">
                    ${filterBarHTML}
                </div>
                <div style="flex:1; min-height:550px; overflow:auto; padding:10px;">
                    <div style="border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:5px; overflow:hidden;">
                        <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; text-align:left; font-size:11px;">
                            <thead><tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #cbd5e1;">${ths}</tr></thead>
                            <tbody class="matrix-table-tbody"></tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:8px 14px; background:#f8fafc; border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:11px; color:#64748b;">
                    <div class="matrix-page-info"></div>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        <button type="button" class="btn-prev-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.prevPage}</button>
                        <span class="matrix-current-page-num"></span>
                        <button type="button" class="btn-next-page" style="padding:3px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; background:#ffffff; border-radius:3px;">${L.nextPage}</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            updateTableOnly();
        }

        container.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-lang-switcher')) {
                componentLang = e.target.value;
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('alliance_matrix_lang', componentLang);
                } catch(err) {}
                render();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.classList.contains('matrix-search-box')) {
                currentPage = 1;
                updateTableOnly();
            }
        });

        container.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            const tagBtn = e.target.closest('.tag-filter-btn') || e.target.closest('.row-tag-badge');
            if (tagBtn && tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag')) {
                const tag = tagBtn.getAttribute('data-tag');
                if (selectedTags.has(tag)) {
                    selectedTags.delete(tag);
                } else {
                    selectedTags.add(tag);
                }
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-clear-tags')) {
                selectedTags.clear();
                currentPage = 1;
                render();
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-prev-page')) {
                if (currentPage > 1) {
                    currentPage--;
                    updateTableOnly();
                }
                return;
            }

            if (e.target.closest('.btn-next-page')) {
                currentPage++;
                updateTableOnly();
                return;
            }
        });

        render();

    } catch (err) {
        console.error("Alliance Motherboard Matrix Render Error:", err);
    }
})();
